title: DSPy Evaluation Metrics
summary: This module provides a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy programs, encompassing LLM-based semantic evaluations for recall, precision, completeness, and groundedness, as well as traditional exact match and F1-score metrics.

nodes.label: Calculate Semantic F1 Score
nodes.title: Semantic F1 Score Calculation
nodes.description: Computes the semantic F1 score between a system's prediction and ground truth using LLM-based precision and recall. Can operate in a decompositional mode for more detailed analysis.

nodes.label: Combine Completeness & Groundedness
nodes.title: Combined Completeness & Groundedness
nodes.description: Combines scores from answer completeness and groundedness evaluations into a single F1-like metric. Utilizes separate modules for each aspect.

nodes.label: Evaluate Semantic Recall & Precision
nodes.title: Semantic Recall & Precision Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature defining the inputs (question, ground truth, system response) and outputs (recall, precision) for LLM-based semantic evaluation.

nodes.label: Decompositional Semantic Recall & Precision
nodes.title: Decompositional Semantic Evaluation
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for detailed semantic evaluation, requiring the LLM to enumerate key ideas, discuss overlap, and then report recall and precision.

nodes.label: Evaluate Answer Completeness
nodes.title: Answer Completeness Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature to estimate the completeness of a system's response against ground truth, involving enumeration of key ideas and discussion of overlap.

nodes.label: Evaluate Answer Groundedness
nodes.title: Answer Groundedness Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature to estimate how well a system's response claims are supported by provided retrieved context, including enumeration of claims and discussion of support.

nodes.label: Check Answer Exact Match
nodes.title: Answer Exact Match Metric
nodes.description: Compares a predicted answer against ground truth(s) for exact match or F1-thresholded match. Handles single or multiple reference answers.

nodes.label: Check Passage for Answers
nodes.title: Passage Contains Answers Check
nodes.description: Determines if a given passage contains any of the specified answers after normalization. Used for retrieval-based evaluations.

nodes.label: Calculate Token Precision
nodes.title: Token-Level Precision Score
nodes.description: Computes token-level precision between a prediction and a ground truth, after text normalization. Precision is the ratio of overlapping tokens to prediction tokens.

nodes.label: Calculate HotPotQA F1 Score
nodes.title: HotPotQA F1 Score
nodes.description: Calculates the HotPotQA-style F1 score, which is a token-level F1 with special handling for 'yes', 'no', 'noanswer' responses.

nodes.label: Match Answer to Passages
nodes.title: Answer-Passage Match Metric
nodes.description: Checks if any passage within a predicted context contains the ground truth answer(s). Normalizes text for robust comparison.

nodes.label: DSPy Module Base Class
nodes.title: BaseModule
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionality for program construction and execution.

nodes.label: DSPy Signature Base Class
nodes.title: SignatureMeta
nodes.description: The metaclass for defining DSPy Signatures, which specify the input/output types and roles for LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Chain of Thought Program
nodes.title: ChainOfThought
nodes.description: A DSPy program that encourages the LLM to generate intermediate reasoning steps before producing a final answer.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.title: Prediction Output
nodes.description: A standard DSPy object used to encapsulate the output of a DSPy program, often including the generated response and other metadata.

groups.label: LLM-based Semantic Evaluation
groups.title: LLM-based Semantic Evaluation
groups.description: Components that leverage Language Models to perform nuanced semantic comparisons between system responses and ground truth, including recall and precision.

groups.label: LLM-based Completeness & Groundedness
groups.title: LLM-based Completeness & Groundedness
groups.description: Components focused on evaluating the completeness of answers against ground truth and the groundedness of claims within retrieved contexts, using Language Models.

groups.label: Exact Match & F1 Metrics
groups.title: Exact Match & F1 Metrics
groups.description: Traditional string-based and token-level metrics for evaluating answer accuracy, including exact match, token precision, and specialized F1 scores.

groups.label: Passage-based Matching
groups.title: Passage-based Matching
groups.description: Utilities for checking if answers are present within provided passages, crucial for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) evaluations.
